outcome: Socioeconomic and clinical profile of obstetric patients admitted to the ICU
cohort: Obstetric patients admitted to the Intensive Care Unit of a public hospital in Pernambuco, Brazil, between January 2017 and December 2018
finding: The majority of obstetric ICU admissions were young adult postpartum women who delivered via cesarean section and had hypertensive syndromes, primarily pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most prevalent delivery type (87.2%).
